name: Alert Lynx

name: Beacon
description: A short beacon with an offset light wedge makes observation and signalling explicit. Plain NIVRA text is independent of the symbol. It is easier to interpret than the abstract alternative, but may suggest maritime/navigation products and its familiar pictorial subject is a differentiation risk. The beam is a graphic metaphor, not a claim of automated alerting.

name: Mantle
